questions.question: What is the reflection of the point (6, -1) in the line y = 2?
questions.solution:
Reflection of point about y = 2 can be given as

Since we know that the X co-ordinate will not change

And the Y coordinate can be given as given

Y co - ordinate + 2 × (Y coordinate of line - given Y co-ordinate)

⇒ -1 + 2 × (2 - (-1)) = 5

∴ The coordinate of reflection is (6, 5)

questions.question: Point P (8, 5) is the midpoint of segment AB. Co-ordinates of A are (5, y) and B are (x, -3). What is the value of x?
questions.solution:
Using mid-point formula for X coordinate

⇒ 8 = (5 + x)/2

⇒ x = 11

∴ x = 11

questions.question: Anil is twice as good as workman as Bimal and together they finish a piece of work in 9 days. In how many days will Anil alone finish the work?
questions.solution:
Let work done by Anil in 1 day be y of the total work

⇒ work done by Bimal in 1 day y/2 of the total work

According to the problem statement

⇒ 9(y + y/2) = 1

⇒ y = 1/(27/2) = 1/13.5

∴ Anil alone can finish the work in 13.5 days

What is the area (in sq. cm) of a circle whose circumference is 22 cm?
questions.solution:
Let radius be r

Given circumference = 2πr = 22

⇒ r = 22/2π = 7/2 cm

Area can be given as πr²

⇒ Area = π(3.5)² = 38.5 cm²

∴ The area of circle is 38.5 cm²

questions.question: If a + b = 10 and ab = 24, then what is the value of a³ + b³?
questions.solution:
Since we know that (a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b), put all the values given values

⇒ 10³ = a³ + b³ + 3 × 24(10)

⇒ a³ + b³ = 280

∴ The value of a³ + b³ is 280

questions.question: The 3rd and 6th term of an arithmetic progression are 13 and -5 respectively. What is the 11th term?
questions.solution:
Let the first term of AP be a and common difference bedFrom the problem’s statement

⇒ 3rd term = a + (3 - 1) d = a + 2d = 13 ----(i)

⇒ 6th term = a + (6 - 1) d = a + 5d = -5 ----(ii)

Now (ii) - (i)

⇒ 3d = -18

⇒ d = - 6, put this in (i)

⇒ a = 13 - (-12) = 25

Now the 11th term can be given as a + 10d

⇒ 11th term = 25 + 10 × (-6) = -35

questions.question: A milkman buys milk at Rs. 25 per litre and adds 1/4 of water to it and sells the mixture at Rs. 26 per litre. His gain (in %) is?
questions.solution:
The milkman mixes 1/4 of 1 litre = 0.25 litre of milk in 1 litre

Cost price of (1 + 0.25 =) 1.25 litres of milk = Rs. 25

Cost price of 1 litre milk = 25/1.25 = Rs. 20

Selling price of 1 litre milk = Rs. 26

∴ Gain % = [(26 - 20)/20] × 100 = 30%

questions.question: In the first 40 overs of a 50 over innings, the run rate was 4.8 runs/over. What is the required run rate in the remaining 10 overs to reach the target of 241 runs?
questions.solution:
Total runs scored in 40 overs can be given as

⇒ 40 overs × 4.8 runs/over = 192 runs

⇒ remaining runs can be given as 241 - 192 = 49 runs

⇒ Run rate can be given as 49/10 = 4.9 runs per over

∴ Required run rate is 4.9 runs per over

questions.question: What is the equation of a line of slope 1/3 and y - intercept 5?
questions.solution:
Since we know that equation of line of form y = mx + c, where m is slope and c is y intercept of the given line

⇒ y = x/3 + 5

⇒ x - 3y = -15

∴ The equation of line is x - 3y = -15

questions.question: What will be the total number of tigers left in the six sanctuaries, if 3 tigers are killed by poachers in sanctuary E and 9 tigers are added to sanctuary A?
questions.solution:
Initially total number of tigers can be given as

⇒ Total tigers = 29 + 11 + 5 + 10 + 22 + 13 = 90

After the poaching and addition of tigers

⇒ Total tigers remaining = 90 - 3 + 9 = 96

∴ Remaining tigers are 96 tigers

questions.question: If the total tiger population in these six sanctuaries had grown by 20% and 25% in the previous two decades, then what was the total tiger population in these six sanctuaries before 20 years?
questions.solution:
Let the tiger population 20 years before be y

Total tiger population after 20 years = 29 + 11 + 5 + 10 + 22 + 13 = 90

According to the problem statement

⇒ y(1 + 20/100)(1 + 25/100) = 90

⇒ y(1.2)(1.25) = 90

⇒ y = 60

∴ The tigers population 20 years back is 60.

questions.question: The sum of a fraction and 3 times its reciprocal is 19/4. What is the fraction?
questions.solution:
Let the fraction be y

According to the problem statement

⇒ y + 3/y = 19/4

⇒ 4y² - 19y + 12 = 0

⇒ (y - 4)(y - 3/4) = 0

The required number is 3/4 which satisfies the above given condition

∴ The value of required fraction is ¾.

questions.question: The amount received at 10% per annum Compound interest after 3 yrs is Rs. 5324. What was the principal (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
Let the principle be p

According to the problem statement

⇒ Amount = p{(1 + 10/100)³}

⇒ 5324 = p(1.331)

⇒ 5324 = 1.331p

⇒ p = 4000

∴ The principle is Rs. 4000

questions.question: Two cyclists P and Q cycle at 20 km/hr and 25 km/hr towards each other. What was the distance (in kms) between them when they started if they met after 56 minutes?
questions.solution:
Relative speed = 20 + 25 = 45 km/hr

Distance travelled in 56 minutes (56/60 hr = 14/15 hr)

⇒ Distance = 45 × 14/15 = 42 km

∴ The initial distance between them is 42 km

questions.question: ΔABC is right angled at B. If ∠A = 30, what is the length of AB (in cm), if AC = 10 cm?
questions.solution:
cos A = AB/AC

⇒ cos 30 = AB/10

⇒ √3 × 10/2 = AB

⇒ AB = 5√3

∴ AB is 5√3 cm

questions.question: When a number is increased by 120, it becomes 130% of itself. What is the number?
questions.solution:
Let the number be y

According to the problem statement

⇒ y + 120 = 130y/100

⇒ 120 = 0.3y

⇒ y = 400

questions.question: A bag has Rs. 51.25 in the form of 2 - rupee, 50 - paise and 25 - paise coins in the ratio of 3 : 5 : 7. What is the total number of 50 - paise coins?
questions.solution:
Let the number of 2 - rupee, 50 - paise and 25 - paise coins be a, b and c

According to the problem statement

⇒ 2a + b/2 + c/4 = 51.25

Given that they are in ratio 3 : 5 : 7, so 2 - rupee, 50 - paise and 25 - paise are 3x, 5x and 7x respectively, put this in the above equation

⇒ 2 × 3x + 5x/2 + 7x/4 = 51.25, Multiply both sides by 4

⇒ 24x + 10x + 7x = 205

⇒ 41x = 205

⇒ x = 5

⇒ 50 - paise coins are 5x = 5 × 5 = 25

∴ There were 25 coins of 50 - paise

questions.question: What is the value of Cot 60 - Sec 45?
questions.solution:
Since we know that cot 60 = 1/√3 and sec 45 = √2, put this in the required equation

⇒ Cot 60 - Sec 45 = 1/√3 - √2 = √3/3 - 3√2/3 = (√3 - 3√2)/3

∴ The value of Cot 60 - Sec 45 is (√3 - 3√2)/3

questions.question: If Cot θ = 24/7, then Sin θ = ?
questions.solution:
Given cot θ = 24/7

Cosec θ can be given as

⇒ Cosec θ = √(cot² θ + 1) = √( 24²/7² + 1) = √{(576 + 49)/7²} = √(25²/7²) = 25/7

⇒ Sin θ = 1/Cosec θ = 7/25

∴ sin θ is 7/25

questions.question: The cost price of an article is x. It is marked up by 150%. It is sold at Rs. 600 after giving 40% discount. What is x (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
Cost price after marking it up by 150%

Cost price after marking up = x × (1 + 150/100) = 2.5x

After 40% discount

⇒ 2.5x(1 - 40/100) = 600

⇒ 2.5x = 600/0.6 = 1000

⇒ x = 400

∴ x is Rs. 400
